newsitem.title: USA: N.Y.S Urban Development delays $600 mln bond sale.
newsitem.headline: N.Y.S Urban Development delays $600 mln bond sale.

text.p: The New York State Urban Development Corp on Thursday for the second time delayed its sale of about $600 million of bonds, saying it now expected to tap the debt market around the week of October 28.

The sale first was scheduled for the week of October 7, but it took the agency a bit longer than anticipated to get the necessary approvals from the federal Department of Housing and Urban Development and other legal entities.
Joe Branca, chief financial officer for Empire State Development, said: "We have now gotten them...That should get us to the final stages."
Empire State Development is the umbrella organization for several bodies, including the Urban Development Corp, which last sold debt on its own in 1974.
